name: chat-composer
title: Chat Composer
description: Compose a draft, insert line breaks and track delivery.
useCases: On a ticket page, a customer submits a comment. If the network is unavailable, the typed text stays in the field for another attempt.
When switching conversations, an operator can return to an unfinished reply. The app stores one draft per conversation and supplies it through value.
task: Send a message from an existing page and keep the draft on failure.
behavior: Without onSend the form shows a local confirmation. Return a Promise from onSend to persist a message. The editor prevents duplicate sends while pending, clears the text on success and keeps it for retry on error. Supply value and onChange together for a controlled draft. This example expects your application to handle POST /api/messages.
